sens_en: to offer sacrifice, to honour the dead
origine_fr: Une main qui tient de la viande au-dessus de l'autel 示 : l'offrande. En haut, 月 est la viande, et 卩 un reste de la main. On le lit dans 祭祀, le culte des ancêtres.
origine_en: A hand holding meat above an altar, 示: an offering. On top, 月 is the meat, and 卩 what remains of the hand. It appears in 祭祀, ancestral rites.

mots.en: to pay one's respects (to the dead)

phrase.zh: 清明节，人们去祭拜祖先。
phrase.pinyin: Qīngmíng jié, rénmen qù jìbài zǔxiān.
phrase.fr: À la fête de Qingming, on va honorer ses ancêtres.
phrase.en: At Qingming, people go to pay respects to their ancestors.
